name: empirefog1944
description: Empire Fog 1944 - Turn-based 2D strategy prototype inspired by Empire Deluxe

scripts.prebuild: npm run assets:generate && npm run prepare:assets
scripts.build:pages: npm run assets:generate && npm run prepare:assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode pages
scripts.preview:release: npm run build:pages && vite preview --mode pages
scripts.assets:generate: node scripts/generate-premium-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-terrain-premium.mjs && node scripts/generate-trailer-units.mjs
scripts.predev: npm run assets:generate && npm run prepare:assets
